items.title: Adobe (ADBE) Turns Creative Cloud And Firefly Into AI Studios With New Partnerships
items.summary: Adobe (NasdaqGS: ADBE) announced major AI product rollouts that turn Creative Cloud and Firefly into fully AI-powered studios. The company introduced agentic AI tools across its creative platforms, aiming to automate complex design and content workflows for users. Adobe expanded its AI partnerships with Google and Microsoft, integrating its creative technologies with widely used productivity and cloud platforms. items.title: 5 beaten-down U.S. large caps with fair value upside above 25%
items.summary: Investing.com -- A screen of US large caps (over $10B market cap) filtered for a 1-year price drop of more than 10%, fair value upside above 25%, ROIC above 12%, and projected 3-year revenue CAGR above 5% returned 14 names. These five stood out because the sell-off looks more like sentiment than damaged earnings power. Screener values are snapshots and may lag live prices. Prices are the Nov 16, 2026 closes.
